facts.raw_span: 6 months of progressive left proptosis
recent ecchymosis and subconjunctival hemorrhage after a sudden rise in blood pressure
intact ocular motility
best-corrected visual acuity of 0.9 in the left eye
normal anterior and posterior segment examinations without optic nerve signs
right eye was anophthalmic following enucleation in 2010 for a large choroidal melanoma
Orbital CT showed a well-defined isodense intraconal lesion measuring 2.6 × 2.5 × 2.4 mm
intrinsic high-density areas, located inferomedially between the optic nerve and inferior rectus, displacing them and scalloping the lamina papyracea
MRI demonstrated a hyperintense mass on T1-weighted images and hypointense signal on T2-weighted images
General physical examination and systemic metastatic evaluation were negative
an incisional biopsy via anterior inferomedial transconjunctival orbitotomy was planned
no adjuvant therapy and was lost to follow-up after 2 years of disease-free status
